Letychiv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Presumed established around 1760, this cemetery served a community that once peaked near 5,911 people in 1910, supporting seven synagogues and two Jewish cemeteries. Letychiv later became a regional collection point for Jews from Bessarabia and neighboring towns during the Nazi occupation, and over 7,000 people died here between 1941 and 1943 across the ghetto's liquidation and the forced-labor camp that followed. The cemetery itself was built over by the Soviet government in the 1970s; only a handful of gravestone traces remain today.
